::: {.callout-tip title="Live app — a client, running"}
Block 2 made clickable, against the live USGS feed. Four things are on display
at once:

- **Query parameters as the interface.** Every control changes the *request*,
  not a filter on a table you already downloaded. Watch the URL above the
  results change as you move the sliders.
- **The three checks.** Status, content type, and shape, each shown as pass or
  fail — so you can see which one caught a problem, not just that something
  broke.
- **Caching keyed on arguments.** Repeat a combination of controls and the
  answer returns without touching the network.
- **Failure, handled.** The *Break it on purpose* control points the same code
  at a `400`, at a `200` that returns HTML, and at a host that does not
  resolve. Try the middle one: the status check passes and the content-type
  check is what stops it.

```{=html}
<iframe
  src="https://YOUR-WEEK11-APP.streamlit.app/?embed=true"
  width="100%" height="700" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px;"
  loading="lazy">
</iframe>
```

Source: [`week11_app/`](https://github.com/gaimsds/dataviz/tree/main/week11_app).
The `?embed=true` on the URL is what hides Streamlit's own chrome inside the
frame. Community Cloud apps sleep when idle, so the first load after a quiet
spell takes a few seconds to wake — which is itself worth noticing: a cold
start is latency your users pay, and it is the argument for caching.
:::
